heading: Why Choose Us to Help You with Your Real Estate Needs in the Williamson County, TN Area?
html:
About Us

Why Choose Us to Help You with Your Real Estate Needs in the Williamson County, TN Area?

At the core of Towne Creek Realty is our belief that being a good steward influences how we serve you, each other, and our community. We believe this makes a difference in our work ethic, our commitment to knowing and understanding real estate, and in both our working and personal relationships.

We pride ourselves in creating long lasting relationships with clients. Our utmost goal is to help buyers and sellers make wise Real Estate decisions. In doing this we have to be honest and forthright.

We offer you the highest level of service by providing an in-depth analysis of your needs, wants, and of course what is realistic. Communication and working together as a team is the key to our success.

Our clients tell us we are unique in the industry by being both data driven and people oriented. We believe if data is analyzed properly it gives us insights that cannot be determined by simply running average comparisons.

heading: What Our Clients Are Saying
html:
Testimonials

What Our Clients Are Saying

"Chris came out to look at our property and was so kind and friendly..."

"We contacted Chris to sell our home in Santa Fe, TN which had been on the market twice before with no luck. Chris came out to look at our property and was so kind and friendly. He was honest with us and let us know what he thought the property would sell for. He went out of his way when showing the home to make sure that we had time to get it ready and he would even go out when it was not him showing it to make sure our dogs were put outside and let back in when the lookers left. I have nothing bad to say about Chris' ability as a realtor. He sold our house within several months when other realtors could not, and helped us find our dream home exactly where we wanted to be. You cannot go wrong using Towne Creek Realty and Chris Thompson."

— Candace Williams

"We absolutely loved our experience with Chris and Towne Creek Realty..."

"It was obvious from the very first appointment that Chris was extremely knowledgeable and a seasoned real estate professional. We really appreciated his honesty and how he helped us prioritize what repairs we needed to add to our to-do list. Once we were ready to list, Chris sent his amazing photographer to our house. I truly believe those pictures played a key role in selling our home. We started getting inquiries immediately and sold our house in just 24 hours! We were shocked to learn we had seven offers, most were OVER asking price. Chris stayed on the phone with us until 10 pm that night, talking us through the offers. He broke it down simply and created a chart for us to easily compare our options."

— Emily Jordan

"Thank you both Chris and Shari for all the help thru this process..."

"The Towne Creek team were always quick and ready to help, very timely in communicating with us, and helpful in laying out the steps along the way. Having already had a relationship with Chris made it all that much better. We will be sure to recommend Towne Creek to all our friends who may need home buying help!"

— Elliot & DeAnna Kelley
